command:
set -euo pipefail; T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/titan-mxmc-test-XXXXXX); git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt/titan-mx-mc-person-continuity-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$T/mx"; cd "$T/mx"; python3 -m py_compile scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mx.py scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mx_unified.py scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mc.py scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mx_inject.py scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mx_hook.py; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mx_test.py; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mx_unified_test.py; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mc_test.py; LIVE=$HOME/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db; python3 - "$LIVE" "$T/unified.db" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys
s=sqlite3.connect('file:'+sys.argv[1]+'?mode=ro',uri=True); d=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[2]); s.backup(d); d.close(); s.close()
PY
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mx_unified.py --db "$T/unified.db" --max-frames 80 --stats > "$T/stats.json"; python3 - "$T/unified.db" "$T" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys,pathlib,json
p=sys.argv[1]; c=sqlite3.connect(p); names={r[0] for r in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'")}; print('HAS_MX',all(x in names for x in ['titan_mx_pulse','titan_mx_mirror','f2_titan_mx_runtime'])); print('SIDE_DBS',[x.name for x in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).glob('*.db')]); print('MX_COUNTS',c.execute('select count(*) from titan_mx_pulse').fetchone()[0],c.execute('select count(*) from titan_mx_mirror').fetchone()[0]); c.close()
PY
cat "$T/stats.json"; echo '===VOICE-BRANCH==='; git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/voice-titan-mc-person-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$T/voice"; cd "$T/voice"; python3 -m py_compile scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mc.py scripts/voice_full_integration.py scripts/voice_full_runtime.py; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_voice_full_integration.py tests/test_titan_mc_person_scope.py
